source.citation: Lee J, et al. Clin Transl Sci 2024;17:e70106.
source.channel_that_worked: main text via Europe PMC fullTextXML; supplement Table S3 via BioStudies S-EPMC11645475 redirecting to ftp.ebi.ac.uk. The Europe PMC supplementaryFiles endpoint returns only images for this article, which is how an earlier note wrongly concluded the per-patient biomarker was figure-only.

published_anchors_verified.what_this_proves: that the dose and concentration columns were read correctly. It does NOT validate the article's clearance method, which is in a Supporting Information file this project does not hold -- the constant is recovered from the published median rather than derived.

arm_score.how_to_read: mae_log10 is the primary loss. geometric_fold_error is the same quantity read as 'off by a factor of x on average'. mae_ml_per_min_per_kg is the back-transformed error in the endpoint's own units. The last two carry no separate test.
arm_score.native_units: nM of venetoclax per mg of daily dose

comparator_score.how_to_read: mae_log10 is the primary loss. geometric_fold_error is the same quantity read as 'off by a factor of x on average'. mae_ml_per_min_per_kg is the back-transformed error in the endpoint's own units. The last two carry no separate test.
comparator_score.native_units: nM of venetoclax per mg of daily dose

stored_error_bootstrap.resampling_unit: observation, which OVERSTATES independence when a patient contributes two visits; the patient-level refitting interval is the one that governs
stored_error_bootstrap.what_this_interval_does_not_price: The draws resample the STORED out-of-fold per-donor errors; the components, the standardisation constants and the ridge penalty are not re-estimated inside each draw. The interval therefore carries the variability of the donors used for SCORING and not the variability of learning on 14 donors, so it is NARROWER than a fully nested bootstrap would be. It is a descriptive interval. A wider interval cannot turn a non-detection into a detection, so this understates the uncertainty of a POSITIVE finding more than that of a negative one.
stored_error_bootstrap.how_to_read: An interval containing zero means no difference was DETECTED. It is never a demonstration that there is none, and at n=15 the design's power is low by construction. The estimate and its uncertainty are the deliverable, not a significance verdict.

refitting_patient_level_bootstrap.why_the_patient_and_not_the_observation: two visits of one patient are not two individuals. Resampling observations would treat them as such and narrow the interval without adding information.

permutation_control.how_to_read: The null permutes the donor labels of the proteome block only, keeping the target CYP arm and the endpoint paired, and refits everything. It will not be centred on zero: the wider arm shrinks harder under an inner-CV penalty and so scores better with no information. An improvement inside the null is an artefact.

primary_visit_1_only.verdict_rule: SUPPORTED requires the refitting patient-level interval to exclude zero, its estimate to be an improvement, and the permutation rank p-value to be at most 0.05.

what_this_cannot_claim.the_baseline_is_not_clinical: no per-patient covariate is published -- age, weight and creatinine clearance appear by sex group only -- so the comparator is the mean. A gain here would be a gain over no information, not over clinical knowledge plus pharmacogenetics, which is what the funding question asks.
what_this_cannot_claim.not_an_auc_or_a_clearance: the endpoint is one timed concentration divided by the daily dose. It is the reciprocal of the article's 'estimated venetoclax CL' and is not an independent endpoint.
what_this_cannot_claim.twelve_patients: a cohort of twelve, two visits each, with two not-detected concentrations. Nothing here can establish an effect size.
what_this_cannot_claim.not_a_pharmacogenetic_comparison: no genotype is published for these patients, so the contrast that matters most to the funding case -- an omic layer against pharmacogenetics -- cannot be formed.
what_this_cannot_claim.one_drug_one_population: venetoclax in elderly patients with chronic lymphocytic leukaemia, median age 71.8, on a dose that three patients had reduced for toxicity.
what_this_cannot_claim.the_in_vitro_donors_are_different_people: the same article reports fifteen hepatocyte donors and twenty microsome lots. Those are not these patients, and no analysis may join them.
